title: CLB-22 shakes things up with demolition
description:
Marines conduct a basic demolition range to maintain proficiency in building and setting off explosives at Camp Lejeune, N.C., Jan. 15, 2017. During the range, combat engineers set off Bangalore torpedoes, M18A1 Claymore mines and a 40 pound cratering charge. The Marines are assigned to Combat Logistics Battalion 22, 2nd Marine Logistics Group. 
Video includes interviews with Gunnery Sgt. Juan Guillen, a combat engineer, and 1st Lt. John Horton, a platoon commander.
